I stand in solidarity with SAG-AFTRA and the WGA in their fight for fair compensation & AI protections.

Always proud to support our unionized brothers and sisters.

#OrganizedLabor #Solidarity

Proud to announce that our office helped secure $175,000 from @NSF for @FollowStevens to advance their AI research in computer vision, natural language processing, and emerging fields to develop new curriculums and teaching tools. https://t.co/NzAhzLG7A3

We are happy to announce that the @NSF has awarded @FollowStevens over $190,000 towards advancing research in AI privacy and fostering interdisciplinary collaboration in mathematics and computer science. 

Proud to see this funding enable transformative research and academic growth!

Even Republicans' own AI is calling them out for cutting Medicaid. When your talking points can’t even fool the algorithm, you know it’s bad. Slashing healthcare for millions isn’t fiscally responsible—it’s reckless. @EnergyCommerce are here fighting back. https://t.co/GpQq1ZKUMT
Should we be harnessing the power of AI to maintain competitiveness globally? Yes. But do you trust DOGE and this Administration to properly safeguard it and do what’s right? I don’t.
That’s EXACTLY why we should ALL be sounding the alarms that Musk and DOGE are using AI models within federal agencies and freely accessing as much sensitive taxpayer data as they want.

A massive amount of data is needed to unleash the power of AI, but I’m concerned that the Trump Administration might be handing our data to tech companies rather than protecting it or using it for the common good. Hence why Musk’s DOGE minions are embedded in dozens of federal departments and agencies.

At an @EnergyCommerce hearing, we heard about the need to create a “National AI Data Reserve” to fully leverage the potential of AI for ALL Americans and the value of that information. https://t.co/3yeUK8hk70

Those of us who read the bill sounded the alarm on the 10-year AI moratorium weeks ago. Loud and clear.

Another reminder why you shouldn’t believe Republican spin on this disastrous bill. https://t.co/DvCDlea2Be https://t.co/9cNrcjuRut

Trump’s AI Action Plan & new executive orders are deeply troubling & undermine responsible AI innovation.
 
My AI Caucus colleagues & I will keep fighting for policies that safeguard AI development & fully leverage the potential of AI for all Americans without giving a handout to Big Tech.

We must all fight to build a cleaner economy, harness new technology like AI, and ensure no community is left behind. 

Honored to speak with @CHCI last week on how we'll make it happen - together. https://t.co/2rht1a6FT7

Families across New Jersey are paying more on their energy bills—and AI data centers are a major reason why.
 
Yet instead of addressing the problem, Republicans keep focusing on everything but the real issue.

Our office has been sounding the alarm & taking action. More to come. https://t.co/xFyHarNfwQ https://t.co/5OaYZBnxOw

Families & small businesses across New Jersey are paying more on their energy bills—and the rapid growth of AI data centers is a major reason why.

That’s why my colleagues & I are holding data centers accountable to ensure our communities aren't continuing to shoulder the cost of these facilities’ energy demands.

Republicans are once again trying to pass a sweeping provision that would block states from creating responsible AI regulations.

States like New Jersey are already leading with common sense guardrails on AI, and this would shut that progress down. 

We’ve fought this before - and we’ll do it again.

📍 @CHCI’s Tech Summit to discuss AI

 🤝 As AI innovates, we must ensure our communities benefit with affordable access and stronger digital skills. Tech can be a bridge, but only if we close the digital divide. Important conversation, with more work ahead. https://t.co/cA0zWaNpQ1

A blanket ban on state AI laws would stop New Jersey from advancing responsible AI regulation and derail the common-sense guardrails we’re already leading on.

Proud to join my colleagues in opposing this last-minute Republican push to add an AI moratorium into the NDAA that would shut down any progress states have already made.

Families across New Jersey are being crushed by rising electricity bills and AI data centers are a major reason why. 

Yet instead of addressing the problem, Republicans keep focusing on everything but the real issue. More to come. https://t.co/EvsMDYJgKo
👏 3rd Place: Jai Malik of Hoboken HS for an app supporting individuals with Microtia through an interactive AI voice assistant. https://t.co/9GC8fcNQbE

Artificial intelligence holds tremendous potential to strengthen the security and resilience of the telecommunications networks Americans rely on every day. As these networks face increasing threats that could disrupt phone service, block access to financial services, or impede emergency response during disasters, we need forward-looking and innovative solutions to protect American families.

While AI innovation is promising, we must ensure that our constituents are not negatively impacted because of the industry's continued growth. New Jersey families have seen their electricity bills increased by 20% because of the rapid growth of energy-intensive AI data centers. Our bills would protect Americans by requiring data centers to generate their own clean energy, transition to 100% renewable sources by 2040, and provide detailed, transparent reporting on their environmental footprint.

Your electric bills are rising... and AI data centers are a major reason why. While AI innovation is promising, we must ensure it's not happening at the expense of our communities. 
 
That’s why we’re taking action to fix the system, so these data centers - not our families - are accountable for their costs.

AI is being used more & more by hackers to carry out sophisticated cyberattacks on our devices & networks.

That’s why I introduced legislation to make sure we’re also using AI to strengthen cybersecurity & protect Americans from foreign threats. https://t.co/HzpULcm2nm

📍Spending time with our future leaders at County Prep in @JerseyCity 

📚 So great visiting County Prep’s Model Gov meeting to hear what they’re learning about and talk to them about our work in Congress (specifically on AI!). Our future is bright with these students. Good luck in Boston!

Important that Anthropic rejected Hegseth’s pressure to allow the DOD to use their technology to enable mass surveillance or the development of weapons without human oversight. 

Removing necessary AI safeguards for military weapons would shake the conscience of our country. We cannot - and will not - allow it to happen.

While AI innovation is promising, we must ensure it's not happening at the expense of our vulnerable communities. 

That's why I joined @RepBonnie on legislation that would analyze the impacts of data centers on surrounding residents. The health & safety of our communities must come first.

https://t.co/y1RHGBPvHE

New Jersey families are being crushed by rising electric bills & AI data centers are a major reason why. 

That's why I've introduced legislation with @RepCasar that would make sure these data centers - not our families - are accountable for their costs.

https://t.co/LZSCrb3TXb

A blanket ban on state AI laws would stop NJ from advancing responsible AI regulation & derail the common-sense guardrails we’re already leading on.

Proud to join my colleagues on legislation that would prohibit Trump's already announced AI executive order from taking effect. https://t.co/EcnQhdqNEt

AI is moving fast, and we need to move faster.

I spoke with @PunchbowlNews about my new bipartisan bill that uses AI to block foreign cyberattacks before they hit while also keeping our digital world safe. 
https://t.co/31nusjl3TC

I’m proud to partner with @RepBonnie on legislation to study the impact of data centers on local residents.

AI innovation should never come at the expense of our vulnerable communities. 
https://t.co/qgDatsqwMM

AI data centers, powerful corporations, and Trump’s illegal wars are raising prices for everyone. 

But we are fighting back. Always know, your fights are my fights. Let’s meet this moment - together. https://t.co/NTZc65BOwy
Families across America are facing rapidly rising utility bills as a result of unprecedented strain on our power grids, including increased demand from AI data centers.

We have been pressing the Administration to ensure families don’t pay higher electric bills to power AI data centers. 

FERC calling on PJM to postpone shifting data center costs onto households is an important step but we need to do more. 

That’s why I am working with @RepCasar to pass our bill that requires data centers to pay their own way by supplying their own clean energy.
https://t.co/gLJRbZ6vbS

My @HouseDemocrats colleagues and I are ready to take action to address AI with the urgency it requires. 

Republicans can't say the same. https://t.co/n4AthVxWbk
